title: The fish that eats itself to death 🐟 #shorts
description: The black swallower can eat a fish ten times its own weight, and sometimes that kills it. #shorts #animals #nature #facts #didyouknow #wildlife
script: Did you know there's a fish that regularly eats prey ten times its own mass? The black swallower lives in the deep ocean, where meals are rare, so it evolved a stomach that stretches like a balloon. It swallows fish twice its own length, walking its jaws down the body until the whole animal is inside. But sometimes the meal is too big to digest. The prey rots first, filling the stomach with gas, and the swallower is dragged upward and bursts, which is how most specimens are found: floating, dead, and full.
